scopeNote: Generic transport-category aircraft sensor atlas for training. Sensor count, technology, channel architecture, exact location, signal conditioning and bus assignment vary by aircraft/engine type. Confirm type-specific data in approved AMM/WDM/SSM/FIM/CMM documentation.

sensors.name: Pitot Pressure Probe
sensors.location: External nose/forward fuselage, separated left/right/standby stations
sensors.signal: Pneumatic pressure to air-data module / pressure transducer
sensors.redundancy: Multiple independent pitot sources/channels
sensors.failureEffect: A blocked or erroneous source can corrupt associated airspeed data; comparison/voting and alternate sources are used by type.

sensors.name: Static Pressure Port
sensors.location: Flush ports on fuselage sides in low-disturbance zones
sensors.signal: Pneumatic pressure to air-data module / transducer
sensors.redundancy: Multiple ports grouped into independent air-data channels
sensors.failureEffect: Erroneous static pressure affects altitude/airspeed/vertical-speed calculations on the associated channel.

sensors.name: Total Air Temperature Probe
sensors.redundancy: One or multiple sources depending on type
sensors.failureEffect: Performance/temperature calculations revert to alternate or degraded data depending on architecture.

sensors.name: Angle of Attack Sensor
sensors.location: External forward fuselage, typically left/right sides
sensors.measures: Local airflow incidence / angle of attack
sensors.sensorType: Heated vane or non-vane AoA transducer
sensors.medium: Signal harness / data interface + heater power
sensors.redundancy: Multiple independent AoA sources common
sensors.failureEffect: Disagreement can trigger source rejection, degraded protections or maintenance messages depending on aircraft.

sensors.name: Inertial Rate Gyro
sensors.sensorType: Ring-laser, fiber-optic or MEMS gyro depending on design
sensors.redundancy: Multiple inertial units with independent sensor triads
sensors.failureEffect: Single-unit failure is normally isolated; multiple inertial failures reduce navigation/attitude redundancy.

sensors.name: Inertial Accelerometer
sensors.redundancy: Multiple inertial units / triads
sensors.failureEffect: Associated inertial solution can be rejected or degraded.

sensors.name: Radio Altimeter
sensors.location: Transceiver in E/E bay with downward-looking antennas
sensors.measures: Height above terrain at low altitude
sensors.redundancy: Dual or multiple radio-altimeter channels common on transport aircraft
sensors.failureEffect: Loss can remove or degrade autoland, flare and terrain-warning functions depending on redundancy.

sensors.name: Cabin Pressure Sensor
sensors.location: Pressure sensing point connected to pressurization controller
sensors.redundancy: Multiple pressure sensing channels may be used
sensors.failureEffect: Controller may switch channels or degrade to alternate/manual pressurization logic.

sensors.name: Cabin Zone Temperature Sensor
sensors.signal: Low-level analog or networked temperature data
sensors.redundancy: Distributed by zone rather than strict channel redundancy
sensors.failureEffect: Affected zone may use default/alternate temperature logic.

sensors.name: Pack / Duct Temperature Sensor
sensors.redundancy: Multiple sensors distributed by duct/pack
sensors.failureEffect: Affected pack/zone can enter fixed/degraded control or shut down on implausible data.

sensors.name: Bleed Air Pressure Sensor
sensors.redundancy: Distributed per engine/bleed branch
sensors.failureEffect: Associated bleed branch may use fallback control or be isolated.

sensors.name: Bleed Air Temperature Sensor
sensors.redundancy: Distributed per source/duct section
sensors.failureEffect: May cause conservative bleed shutdown or degraded regulation.

sensors.name: Continuous Fire / Overheat Detection Loop
sensors.signal: Loop resistance/capacitance/pressure characteristic to detector unit
sensors.redundancy: Dual loops common in critical fire zones
sensors.failureEffect: One failed loop generally leaves reduced detection; dual-loop loss removes normal detection coverage.

sensors.name: Cargo Smoke Detector
sensors.redundancy: Multiple detectors / zones
sensors.failureEffect: Coverage degrades and dispatch restrictions may apply.

sensors.name: Fuel Quantity Capacitance Probe
sensors.location: Multiple vertical/angled probes inside each fuel tank
feeds: Fuel Quantity Indicating System / FQIS computer
sensors.redundancy: Multiple probes mathematically combined per tank
sensors.failureEffect: Single probe loss normally degrades tank accuracy; multiple failures can invalidate quantity computation.

sensors.name: Fuel Temperature Sensor
sensors.redundancy: Typically distributed by tank/system need
sensors.failureEffect: Temperature indication or related advisories may be lost/degraded.

sensors.name: Fuel Low-Level Sensor
sensors.location: Low-level threshold positions in tanks/collector cells
sensors.measures: Fuel presence below a defined level
sensors.sensorType: Capacitance, optical or discrete level sensor
sensors.redundancy: Multiple sensors may cover tanks/collector cells
sensors.failureEffect: Can cause nuisance or missing low-level warning/transfer logic depending on architecture.

sensors.name: Hydraulic Pressure Transducer
sensors.location: Pressure manifold for each hydraulic system
sensors.redundancy: At least one sensing channel per independent hydraulic system; architecture varies
sensors.failureEffect: Affected pressure indication/automatic logic may degrade while mechanical pressure can remain available.

sensors.name: Hydraulic Fluid Temperature Sensor
sensors.redundancy: Distributed by hydraulic system
sensors.failureEffect: Loss removes or degrades overtemperature monitoring for the affected channel.

sensors.name: Hydraulic Reservoir Quantity Sensor
sensors.redundancy: One or more sensors per reservoir depending on type
sensors.failureEffect: Crew may lose reliable reservoir-quantity indication while system can remain pressurized.

sensors.name: Flight Control Surface Position Sensor
sensors.location: Aileron, elevator, rudder, spoiler or actuator hinge/servo location
sensors.redundancy: Multiple sensing elements/channels common on primary controls
sensors.failureEffect: FCC can reject a failed channel; multiple failures can degrade control law or actuator availability.

sensors.name: Pilot Control Position Sensor
sensors.redundancy: Dual/triple sensing channels depending on control architecture
sensors.failureEffect: Failed channels are cross-compared; sufficient multiple failures can degrade or remove that command input path.

sensors.name: Flap / Slat Position Sensor
sensors.location: Flap/slat drive train, gearbox or surface mechanisms
sensors.redundancy: Multiple position/skew sensors distributed along drive system
sensors.failureEffect: System may stop movement or lock out affected function to prevent asymmetry.

sensors.name: Landing Gear Proximity Sensor
sensors.location: Gear/door uplock, downlock and door mechanisms
feeds: Proximity Switch Electronics Unit / landing gear computer
sensors.redundancy: Multiple sensors at critical positions
sensors.failureEffect: Can create ambiguous gear/door state and inhibit automatic sequencing or produce warnings.

sensors.name: Wheel Speed Transducer
sensors.redundancy: One or more sensors per braked wheel
sensors.failureEffect: Antiskid/autobrake capability for affected wheel/channel can be degraded or disabled.

sensors.name: Brake Temperature Sensor
sensors.redundancy: Distributed per wheel/brake
sensors.failureEffect: Temperature monitoring for the affected brake is lost; braking function itself may remain available.

sensors.name: Tire Pressure Sensor
sensors.location: Wheel/tire valve or wheel-mounted transmitter depending on type
sensors.redundancy: Distributed per tire; not universal on all transport types
sensors.failureEffect: Pressure monitoring is lost for that tire; manual inspection remains required.

sensors.name: N1 / Fan Speed Sensor
sensors.sensorType: Magnetic speed pickup / phonic wheel sensor
sensors.redundancy: Multiple sensing channels may be used by FADEC architecture
sensors.failureEffect: FADEC may use alternate speed sensing or enter degraded control; exact response is engine-specific.

sensors.name: N2 / Core Speed Sensor
sensors.redundancy: Redundant channels depending on engine
sensors.failureEffect: Can degrade FADEC control/start monitoring and invoke alternate sensing logic.

sensors.name: Exhaust Gas Temperature Thermocouples
sensors.signal: Millivolt thermocouple signal to signal conditioner/FADEC
sensors.redundancy: Multiple thermocouples averaged/validated around annulus
sensors.failureEffect: Individual probe loss can be tolerated; broad sensing failure degrades temperature protection/indication.

sensors.name: Engine Fuel Flow Transmitter
sensors.sensorType: Turbine/Coriolis/other certified flow transmitter depending on engine
sensors.redundancy: Usually one measuring path per engine with computational cross-checks
sensors.failureEffect: Fuel-flow indication/calculated fuel-used accuracy can be lost while engine control may continue via other parameters.

sensors.name: Engine Oil Pressure Sensor
sensors.location: Oil pressure manifold / bearing supply circuit
sensors.redundancy: One or more pressure channels per engine depending on design
sensors.failureEffect: False/absent indication can drive maintenance or protective logic; actual lubrication status must be distinguished from sensor failure.

sensors.name: Engine Oil Temperature Sensor
sensors.redundancy: Engine-specific
sensors.failureEffect: Temperature monitoring/trending degrades; FADEC may use fallback assumptions.

sensors.name: Engine Oil Quantity Sensor
sensors.redundancy: Typically one quantity system per engine
sensors.failureEffect: Quantity indication becomes unreliable; manual servicing checks may be required.

sensors.name: Engine Vibration Sensor
sensors.location: Bearing case / fan or core structural locations
sensors.redundancy: Multiple pickups may monitor fan/core axes
sensors.failureEffect: Vibration monitoring/trending degrades; engine mechanical function is not directly controlled by the sensor.

sensors.name: APU Speed Sensor
sensors.redundancy: Control-channel redundancy is APU-specific
sensors.failureEffect: APU may abort start or shut down if reliable speed feedback is unavailable.

sensors.name: APU EGT Sensor
sensors.redundancy: APU-specific probe/channel arrangement
sensors.failureEffect: APU can abort start/shut down or lose temperature indication depending on fault logic.

sensors.name: Ice Detector
sensors.location: External probe in representative icing airflow
sensors.redundancy: One or multiple detectors depending on aircraft
sensors.failureEffect: Automatic icing detection may be lost; manual anti-ice selection/procedures remain type-dependent.
